THE QUICK HOW-TO

Small task. Sorted.

Select a JPEG, PNG or WebP image, choose an output format and adjust quality. The browser decodes the image and exports a new file. Smaller output is not guaranteed, especially for already compressed images.

Try this example

Try WebP at 80% quality, then compare the downloaded file and its size with your original.

Good to know

What happens to transparency and metadata?

JPEG fills transparent areas with white. WebP supports transparency. Canvas export typically removes original camera metadata. Animated images are not supported.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
